regimes.name: Standard-rated domestic supplies
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Ordinary domestic taxable goods/services without an applicable zero-rating, exemption or special treatment.
conditions: Confirm VAT registration, place/date of supply, taxable value and item/service classification.
Restaurant/hospitality, commercial memberships, ordinary retail/trade and workshop charges have no industry-wide relief established here.
A corporate free-zone concession does not determine VAT.

regimes.name: Conditional export zero-rating
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Eligible exports under VAT Law Article 45 and the applicable Executive Regulation.
conditions: Check goods/service distinction, destination, recipient, export evidence and statutory time limits.
Foreign customer address or free-zone status alone does not establish zero-rating.
Import and domestic reverse-charge cases require their own classification.

regimes.name: Qualifying human healthcare
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Necessary human medical/preventive services meeting Article 41 licensing and recipient conditions.
conditions: Confirm licensed provider, treatment purpose and contractual recipient.
Elective cosmetic treatment and incidental holiday/entertainment care do not automatically qualify.
Healthcare service classification is distinct from medicine sales.

regimes.name: Specified medications and medical equipment
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Products meeting Cabinet Decision 56 of 2017 definitions and registration/import-approval requirements.
conditions: Retain product-specific regulatory evidence; a pharmacy shelf or supplier category is insufficient.
The cited decision names Ministry of Health and Prevention approval; verify any successor-authority and product-list changes.
Review the October 2026 medical-product amendment before extending this candidate to later tax points.

regimes.name: Specified VAT exemptions
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Classify statutory exemptions where the actual supply qualifies; not an industry exemption.
conditions: Article 46 covers specified financial services, residential property subject to exceptions, bare land and local passenger transport.
Exempt is distinct from zero-rated and outside-scope; no percentage is assigned.
Consider attributable input-tax restrictions and mixed-business apportionment.

regimes.name: VAT registration assessment
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Separate VAT registration gate for resident/non-resident taxable persons.
conditions: Resident mandatory threshold: taxable supplies/imports exceed AED 375000 over the preceding 12 months or expected next 30 days.
Voluntary threshold: qualifying supplies/imports or taxable expenses exceed AED 187500 under the relevant time tests.
Non-residents making UAE taxable supplies can require registration without a threshold unless another UAE party accounts for the VAT.
Registration is not determined by the separate AED 375000 Corporate Tax income band.

regimes.name: Input VAT recovery and attribution
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Registered business purchases subject to evidence, use and recovery conditions.
conditions: Allocate mixed taxable/exempt and business/private use; validate invoice and payment requirements.
Review blocked entertainment and personally available vehicle inputs and statutory exceptions.
Review anti-evasion due-diligence rules and the dated October 2026/2027 amendments.

regimes.name: Designated-zone goods and services
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Potential special territorial treatment for qualifying goods transactions in specified VAT Designated Zones.
conditions: A free zone must meet the separate VAT Designated Zone tests; do not assume every free zone qualifies.
Services follow ordinary UAE VAT place-of-supply rules.
Goods consumption, movement and import evidence determine treatment; outside-scope is not zero-rated.
Recheck the current zone list and later amendments before use.

regimes.name: Future Executive Regulation amendments review
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Review marker only for Cabinet Decision 149 of 2026; not a current rule as at 15 September 2026.
conditions: The September consolidated publication contains changes effective 1 October 2026, including medical-product wording and recovery provisions.
Selected Article 55 apportionment changes begin from the first tax year commencing after 1 October 2027.
Obtain clause-specific effective text and implementing decisions before generating a successor rule; this marker carries no rate.

regimes.name: Ordinary Corporate Tax lower income band
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Ordinary taxable persons: the portion of taxable income not exceeding AED 375000.
conditions: Applies to financial years beginning on or after 1 June 2023; entity's actual first tax period must be established.
Taxable income is determined after applicable adjustments; this is not a VAT or turnover threshold.
Qualifying Free Zone Persons have separate rate rules.

regimes.name: Ordinary Corporate Tax upper income band
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Ordinary taxable persons: the portion of taxable income exceeding AED 375000.
conditions: Confirm legal form, residence, first financial year, exemptions, elections and tax adjustments.
Not a flat tax on revenue or invoice value; top-up tax can require separate treatment.

regimes.name: Qualifying Free Zone Person qualifying income
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Only Qualifying Income of a person satisfying the Qualifying Free Zone Person requirements.
conditions: Validate applicable qualifying/excluded activities, income source, substance, audited statements, transfer pricing and de minimis requirements for the tax period.
Free-zone incorporation, VAT Designated Zone status or a distribution industry label alone is insufficient.
Detailed activity eligibility and latest implementing decisions remain unverified.

regimes.name: Qualifying Free Zone Person non-qualifying taxable income
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Non-qualifying taxable income within the relevant Qualifying Free Zone Person rules.
conditions: No ordinary AED 375000 zero band applies to this category.
Review permitted taxable income categories separately from breaches that disqualify the person from the free-zone regime.

regimes.name: Small Business Relief election review
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Conditional election treating eligible resident persons as having no taxable income for the relevant period; not a POS rate.
conditions: Review AED 3000000 revenue ceiling in the current and relevant earlier periods and excluded persons.
Qualifying Free Zone Persons and specified multinational-group members cannot elect.
MoF announcement dated 7 August 2026 extends qualifying period ends through 31 December 2029; older guides still show 2026.
Obtain Ministerial Decision 131 of 2026 and its commencement text; legal commencement of this amended version remains unverified.

regimes.name: Natural-person business scope
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Determine whether a natural person's UAE business is within Corporate Tax.
conditions: Review combined business turnover exceeding AED 1000000 in the calendar year.
Wages, personal investment and qualifying real-estate investment income are treated separately.
Do not interpret absence of salary income tax as exemption for a sole business.

regimes.name: Withholding on specified UAE-sourced non-resident income
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Specified state-sourced income of non-residents within the Corporate Tax withholding provisions.
conditions: Assess recipient residence, permanent-establishment connection and income category.
Separate payer withholding records from output VAT and entity profit-tax computation.
A zero withholding rate does not exempt the underlying business or transaction from other taxes.

regimes.name: Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax scope review
regimes.authority: Federal Tax Authority / UAE Ministry of Finance
regimes.jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates; federal, subject to mainland/free-zone and transaction conditions
regimes.applicability: Separate regime for in-scope constituent entities of multinational groups.
conditions: Review global consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million in at least two of the preceding four financial years.
Applies to financial years starting on or after 1 January 2025; group-level rules prevent a universal invoice rate.
Detailed effective-tax-rate computation is outside this early catalog.

open_questions: Obtain qualified UAE review of mainland/free-zone legal status, entity form, residence, VAT registration, actual financial year and product/supply classifications.
No general positive reduced VAT rate below 5 percent was established for these industries; do not import the UK's reduced-rate category or equate zero-rating with exemption.
The September 2026 Executive Regulation includes future provisions. Compare the 2025 text and clause footnotes; publication date is not operative date.
Verify current medical-product lists, successor regulator approvals and the October 2026 implementing decision before approving pharmacy SKUs.
FTA VATP016 B2B healthcare clarification was located but its full PDF could not be retrieved; contractual-recipient interpretation remains unverified and requires review.
MoF's 7 August 2026 Small Business Relief extension supersedes the 2026 end date in older guides, but the amending decision's full text/commencement was not obtained.
Revalidate current free-zone qualifying/excluded activities, de minimis, substance, audited statements and distribution requirements; no industry profile confers qualification.
Arabic legislation is authoritative; several FTA English PDFs explicitly identify themselves as unofficial translations.

Invoice/e-invoice requirements, tax points, credit notes, rounding, customs, excise, local hospitality levies, deemed supplies, reverse charge and margin schemes need separate implementation research.
Null rates/commencement are unresolved or non-rate rules, never zero defaults; end dates in this catalog are inclusive period limits where stated.
All entries remain unreviewed and disabled; neither these files nor the AED currency field activate runtime currency, tax, filing or payment support.
